title: Tall Candle
body:
"A dyeable candle that's very tall, great for decoration."

Description

The Tall Candle is part of the candle series of items sold at the Monstrous Manor for the 2025 Halloween event. It can be bought at the Monstrous Manor or from Halloween Poppers. This version is slimmer and taller than the others. It resembles a more traditional candle, rather than the big and small candles.

Trivia

  • This item (like all the other candles) can be dyed.
  • When interacted with, it can be lit up with [f] [image needed]
